aaa_enabled.summary: Configure Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) in the Cato portal.
aaa_enabled.notes: Configure Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) or SSO in the Cato Management Application (CMA) under Access > User Authentication.

secure_vty_transport.summary: Administrative transport restriction is strictly HTTPS-only.
secure_vty_transport.notes: Cato SASE Cloud only supports encrypted HTTPS web administration and API channels. Legacy cleartext protocols are not supported.

vty_idle_timeout.notes: Set the administrative inactivity timeout in the Cato Management Application (CMA) under Administration > Account Settings.

enable_secret_encrypted.summary: Ensure passwords/secrets are stored as hashes.
enable_secret_encrypted.notes: Passwords and secrets are encrypted and hashed by default in the Cato SASE Cloud platform database.

no_default_snmp_community.summary: SNMP read/write communities are not supported on Cato Networks cloud endpoints.
no_default_snmp_community.notes: SNMP query services are managed via the CMA or API. Traditional SNMP communities are not applicable.

http_server_disabled.notes: Cato Networks strictly enforces HTTPS-only administrative access across all cloud consoles.

ssh_version_2.notes: SSH command-line management access is not supported on Cato SASE Cloud endpoints.

logging_enabled.summary: Configure Event Integration to forward events to a remote syslog/SIEM target.
logging_enabled.notes: Configure Event Integration in the Cato Management Application (CMA) under Administration > Event Integration.

management_acl.summary: Restrict API/CMA access to specific administration IP ranges.
management_acl.notes: Go to Cato Management Application > Administration > API Keys or Account Settings to restrict allowed IP ranges.

login_banner.notes: Enable the disclaimer screen in the Cato Management Application under Access > User Authentication.

password_min_length.notes: Define password complexity and length requirements in the CMA under Access > User Authentication.

ntp_configured.summary: NTP services are managed automatically by Cato SASE Cloud.
ntp_configured.notes: Cato SASE Cloud endpoints synchronize automatically via internal Cloud NTP pools.

no_write_snmp_community.notes: SNMP communities are not applicable to Cato cloud services.
